label: Slack bot token
name: slack_bot_token
hint: xoxb-... needs users:read and users:read.email, to look up each recipient's address. Blank builds the email with no recipients.

label: Azure OpenAI key
name: azure_api_key
hint: Optional. Writes the 'month in brief' paragraph. Blank, or a reply that fails its checks, uses a plain template instead.

label: Azure OpenAI URL
name: azure_url
hint: Optional. Leave blank for the default gpt-4o deployment.

label: Channel name
name: channel_name
hint: Shown in the email, without the #. Default plank-you-very-much.

label: Channel link
name: channel_url
hint: Optional. The link behind the Join button, e.g. https://coursera.enterprise.slack.com/archives/C0123ABCD

label: Channel ID
name: channel_id
hint: The channel's Slack ID, which starts with C (C0123ABCD) -- not its name. Open the channel, then About, and copy the ID at the bottom. The bot token needs channels:read (groups:read for a private channel), and a private channel must have the bot in it. Used to list the members to write to.

label: Send to
name: recipients_from
hint: members = everyone in the channel (the default when channel_id is set; if they cannot be listed there are NO recipients and ok is false); ever = everyone who has ever logged; active = only people who logged this month (the default without channel_id).

label: Section order
name: section_order
hint: Comma separated, in the order they should appear. Names: brief, tiles, trend, checkins, together, milestones, move, strength, mind, habits (or activities for all four), highlights, calendar, boards, challengers, records, games, join. A section you leave out is left out of the email. Blank = brief, tiles, trend, checkins, together, milestones, activities, highlights, calendar, boards, challengers, records, games, join.

label: Month
name: month
hint: Blank = this month so far. 'previous' = last month, complete (use this for a recipe scheduled on the 1st). Or YYYY-MM.

label: Subject icon
name: subject_icon
hint: Optional. An emoji put at the front of the subject. Blank = 💪. 'none' = no icon, the subject as it was. Paste the emoji itself: a Slack :shortcode: shows as text in email.

label: Hero banner URL
name: hero_image_url
hint: Optional. Must be a PUBLIC https image. A Slack file URL shows as a broken image in email and is ignored.

label: Section banner URLs (JSON)
name: section_image_urls
hint: Optional JSON object of PUBLIC https images, keyed by section: checkins, move, strength, mind, habits, highlights, calendar, together, milestones, boards, challengers, records, games. e.g. {"move": "https://.../move.png"}. A section with no image uses its coloured band.

label: Name people
name: show_names
hint: Default on. Off removes every name from highlights, badges and boards and keeps the counts.

toggle_field.label: Name people
toggle_field.name: show_names
toggle_field.hint: Default on. Off removes every name from highlights, badges and boards and keeps the counts.

label: Show the podium
name: show_leaderboard
hint: Default on. The all-time top three for steps, pushups and plank, plus any activities you add below.

toggle_field.label: Show the podium
toggle_field.name: show_leaderboard
toggle_field.hint: Default on. The all-time top three for steps, pushups and plank, plus any activities you add below.

label: More podium activities
name: board_activities
hint: Optional, comma separated, e.g. workout, read, yoga. Each gets a podium in 'On the boards', after steps, pushups and plank and in the order you list them. A person needs 5 logged days in an activity to be placed. Sleep, fasting and hydration are never ranked.

label: Podiums: minimum people
name: board_min_people
hint: Default 5. Any other activity gets a podium by itself once this many people logged it this month. Lower it for more podiums without naming them.

label: Show badges earned
name: show_badges
hint: Default off. When on, a 'Badges earned' list appears under the highlights: the badges people earned this month, by showing up. Left off until people are familiar with badges.

toggle_field.label: Show badges earned
toggle_field.name: show_badges
toggle_field.hint: Default off. When on, a 'Badges earned' list appears under the highlights: the badges people earned this month, by showing up. Left off until people are familiar with badges.

label: Show profile photos
name: show_photos
hint: Default on. A small Slack profile photo beside each name in 'On the boards', 'Channel records to beat' and 'Brain games'; initials for anyone without a photo of their own. Needs the Slack bot token, and 'show names' on. Off = names only, as before.

toggle_field.label: Show profile photos
toggle_field.name: show_photos
toggle_field.hint: Default on. A small Slack profile photo beside each name in 'On the boards', 'Channel records to beat' and 'Brain games'; initials for anyone without a photo of their own. Needs the Slack bot token, and 'show names' on. Off = names only, as before.

label: Use saved Slack profiles
name: use_saved_profiles
hint: Default on. Each person's Slack name, email and photo is kept in a data table row (row_type plank_you_very_much_user), and Slack is asked only about people with no row yet. To refresh somebody (new photo, new address) delete their row; the next run asks Slack again. Off = ask Slack about everyone, every run, and save nothing. A dry run reads the rows but never writes them.

label: Records: minimum people
name: records_min_people
hint: Default 4. An activity's record appears under 'Channel records to beat' once this many people have ever logged it.

label: Sections: minimum people
name: section_min_people
hint: Default 2. An activity logged this month is listed in its section once this many people have ever logged it. 1 lists everything logged this month. One nobody logged this month is never listed.

label: Always list these activities
name: always_show_activities
hint: Default swim. Comma separated, e.g. swim, cycle. Listed in their section even with fewer people than the minimum, when logged this month. 'none' for no exceptions.

label: More milestone activities
name: milestone_activities
hint: Optional, comma separated, e.g. workout, meditate. Added to the milestones section after steps, pushups and plank, which are always shown. Sleep and fasting have no milestone.

label: Trend chart: months
name: trend_months
hint: Default 12, which is also the most: the chart is counted from each person's logged days, and about a year of those is kept. Months before the channel began are not shown.

label: Dry run (testing)
name: dry_run
hint: Default off. On: you get the email, subject and recipients exactly as normal, but nothing is stored in the data table. Use it for test sends; turn it off for the real month-end run.

label: Save totals for next month
name: save_snapshot
hint: Default on. Saves today's channel totals in a row of this step's own (row_type email_summary_snapshot), so next month's email can say exactly what was added. Turn off for a test run you do not want remembered.

label: Allowed email domains
name: allowed_email_domains
hint: Optional, comma separated, e.g. coursera.org. Anyone outside them is left off the recipients and listed in missing_emails.

label: Timezone offset (seconds)
name: tz_offset
hint: Seconds east of UTC, to decide what today is. Default -25200 (as spotter).

label: Today (testing)
name: today
hint: Optional YYYY-MM-DD, to build the email as of another day.

label: Skip email lookup (testing)
name: skip_email_lookup
hint: Builds the email without calling Slack for addresses.
